summaries.Oral reading: Read aloud in the printed order. Pronounce words clearly and pause at punctuation. Teachers assess accuracy and fluency; the printed text is the oral response.
summaries.Demonstratives: Use sentence meaning, subject agreement and time clues to choose the word or verb form. Apply the specific rule explained for each task and note ambiguous choices.
